rules.statement: The court has the power to amend a consent order under section 189(1) of the Civil Procedure Code if there was an accidental slip or omission by counsel, even though it pertains to terms agreed upon by the parties.
rules.supporting_quote: "Of consent, plaintiff to be entitled to half share of premises described in schedule to plaint with damages fixed at Rs. 100.00. 266 Writ for damages not to issue for 3 months from today. Each party to bear his own costs. Enter decree accordingly."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: "(1) The court may at any time, either on its own motion or on that of any of the parties, correct any clerical or arithmetical mistake in any judgment or order or any error arising therein from any accidental slip or omission, or may make any amendment which is necessary to bring a decree into conformity with the judgment."
